title: App Trailer
description: A landscape 16:9 three-scene product trailer: an opening app name + tagline, a staggered three-feature reveal, and a closing call-to-action. Highest demo value for SaaS/app products.
use_case: Product or feature trailer for an app, SaaS tool, or website.
recommended_voice_note: Smooth Dev — smooth, confident; fits product trailers. Override per prompt tone.
variables_note: data-composition-variables in index.html is the source of truth; this list mirrors it for routing.
voiceover_note: Voiceover is build-time-substituted into the <audio> src (__VOICEOVER_URL__), NOT a runtime data-composition-variable. generate-voiceover synthesizes it; apply_voiceover.py injects it. Voice = recommended_voice_id unless the prompt directs otherwise.
